[ASSISTANT_SAID] To encourage open communication and avoid misunderstandings in a diverse team, establish clear expectations, encourage active listening, respect cultural differences, use inclusive language, foster a safe environment, and face conflicts.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] If someone is constantly interrupting even when they're on mute, use visual cues, call them out in a respectful way, and follow up in private.  
[USER] User inquires about handling interruptions if the person interrupting is the team leader or manager.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If the team leader or manager is interrupting, address it privately, be tactful, avoid accusing, suggest alternative ways for communication, and seek support from colleagues if needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested solutions for addressing interruptions include taking notes while team members speak or waiting until the end of the conversation to voice opinions.
